bn.drop: Tooltip of the "×" button of a stacked chart; {name} = chart label.
bn.h.nParams: Line above the scan header table; {n} = number of parameters.
bn.iso.failed: Warning when the isotope profile cannot be calculated; {message} = error text.
bn.scan.count: Line below the list of the "+ scan" picker; {n} = number of scans.
bn.l.count: Line above the list of scans; {n} = number of scans.
bn.f.rtType: Second row of a scan type ("Scans by type" section); {a} and {b} = first and last RT in minutes.
bn.maxRanges: Warning when the maximum number of stacked charts is exceeded; {n} = maximum.
bn.sub.count: Line above the XIC-from-formula table; {hit} = subformulas with a signal, {n} = subformulas tried.
bn.sub.label: Label of the XIC-from-formula chart; {formula} = formula of the ion, {ppm} = tolerance.
bn.idn.spec: Line above the search button; {rt} = RT with unit, {mz} = precursor m/z, {pol} = + or −.
bn.idn.dl: Accessible name and tooltip of the download icon; {name} = name and version of the library.
bn.idn.site: Accessible name and tooltip of the globe icon; {name} = name and version of the library.
bn.idn.row.ok: Tooltip of an active library row; {name} = library name, {n} = number of spectra.
bn.idn.row.pol: Tooltip of a library row switched off because of a different polarity; {name} = name, {n} = number of spectra.
bn.idn.row.lvl: Tooltip of a library row switched off because it is of MSn level while the spectrum is MS2; {name} = name, {n} = number of spectra.
bn.idn.row.noSpec: Tooltip of a library row disabled because no MS2 spectrum is chosen; {name} = name, {n} = number of spectra.
bn.idn.row.userOn: Tooltip of a library row ticked by the user; {name} = name, {n} = number of spectra.
bn.idn.row.userOff: Tooltip of a library row unticked by the user; {name} = name, {n} = number of spectra.
bn.idn.loadedN: First part of the message after loading files or a folder; {n} = libraries loaded.
bn.idn.ignN: Button that opens the list of files left out; {m} = how many files were not read.
bn.idn.ign.partD: Reason, for a partly read file; {p} = spectra without a precursor, {k} = without peaks, {b} = damaged.
bn.idn.ign.more: Last entry of a list truncated to 200 names; {n} = names not shown.
